mentions.name: AuraJoie
mentions.description: A calm, private space for sharing meaningful photo albums with family and friends. It strips out likes, feeds, and social noise, focusing on memory moments instead of social media engagement.
mentions.problem: Social photo sharing is noisy with likes and feeds, distracting from meaningful memories.
mentions.audience: People sharing meaningful photo albums with family and friends; early users use it for family trips, kids, and quiet reflections.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on AuraJoie, a calm, private space to share meaningful photo albums with family and friends.

No likes, no feeds, no noise... just beautiful albums and good energy.
